answer: A random beacon is a prism: one unpredictable draw spot-checks random agents each epoch. Each agent must crack a walnut, a small puzzle keyed to the beacon, and hold a live compute heartbeat proving a real machine behind it. Faking 1,000 agents means 1,000 puzzles: $0.02 each, 5 checks per epoch, $100 per epoch, while one honest agent pays $0.10, its rewards undiluted. A fake vine withers the moment its operator stops paying.
